purpose: Resolve model_revision_resolved for the Sofja judge runs, which recorded null.
problem: The Sofja copy of the judge weights was transferred offline as a flat directory, so it carries no .cache/huggingface/download metadata and the runtime could not resolve a revision. The ANTS copy was downloaded by huggingface_hub and does carry that metadata.
method: Compare the two copies on every non-weight file plus a name+size fingerprint over all 30 safetensors shards. Identity of these establishes the same repository snapshot.

shard_fingerprint.definition: sha256 of `stat -c '%n %s' model-*.safetensors`, i.e. the ordered filename+byte-size list of all 30 shards

corroboration: 148 judge response rows produced on ANTS with model_path ending Selene-1-Llama-3.3-70B record model_revision_resolved = 37ad448f3d1ab7579cbccb0d8418b2808573a30b. 84 rows produced on Sofja record null.
conclusion: The Sofja judge weights are the same repository snapshot as the ANTS weights: revision 37ad448f3d1ab7579cbccb0d8418b2808573a30b.
what_this_does_NOT_establish: The 30 safetensors shards were not hashed byte-for-byte on either host; that would mean reading ~140 GB twice on shared filesystems and would require a Slurm allocation. The evidence is: byte-identical index (which enumerates every tensor and its shard assignment), byte-identical config and tokenizer, and identical shard sizes. Undetected divergence would require a shard edit that preserves every file size and the index. This is treated as sufficient for provenance, and the limit is stated rather than glossed.
action_taken: No artifact was rewritten. The recorded null stands in the run outputs as the honest record of what the runtime could resolve; this file supplies the revision externally.
